goal: Input validation review: untrusted input checked for type, length, range and format at the boundary.
use: Input validation review: untrusted input checked for type, length, range and format at the boundary. Use when code reads request, file, queue or user input.

steps.note: List the entry points. Routes, handlers, queue consumers and file readers.
Check each input. Flag inputs used without a type, length or range check.
Check placement. Validation should sit at the boundary, not deep in the code.
Check allow-lists. Flag deny-lists used where allow-lists are possible.
Report. Each entry point with its gap, file and line, and the fix.
